title: Halcyon: the phishing wave
intro: Someone is phishing Halcyon staff from a lookalike domain. Take the kit apart, read what the attackers left behind, and catch the wave in the SOC.
outro: You followed the phishing wave from the kit to the SOC queue. The attackers' plan is clear: three a.m.
q1.story: Start where the attackers started: take apart the phishing kit that fooled an employee.
q2.story: Read the headers of a fake billing email and see who really sent it.
q3.story: A message intercepted from the Halcyon mail relay is encrypted. Break it.
q4.story: The attackers left a note in the same cipher style. Read their plan.
q5.story: Now sit in the SOC. With the kit's signs fresh, triage the mail that is still arriving.
